POPULAR TOURNAMENTS
Americano: Americano is a popular tournament format in padel where players compete in teams of two. It follows a round-robin format, where each team plays against every other team in the tournament. Mexicano: Mexicano is a thrilling padel tournament format that combines elements of singles and doubles play. Each team consists of three players, and matches are played in a rotating format. The three players take turns playing singles matches against the opposing team, resulting in a dynamic and strategic gameplay experience. Mexicano offers a unique twist to traditional padel tournaments.

Mixicano: Mixicano is a fun and inclusive padel tournament format that promotes gender diversity and teamwork. It is a mixed doubles tournament where each team consists of one male and one female player. Mixicano tournaments encourage players of all skill levels to participate and enjoy the sport together.
